heading: Strength is recent price. Growth is growing and already profitable. Cheap on operating profit is valuation.

strength.name: Strength
strength.method: Hot tape — recent price, not a forecast. 60% 63-session return and 40% 252-session return among liquid names with a full QQQ calendar. The published list is the top 10% of that tape, at most 150 names.

growth.name: Growth
growth.method: Growing companies that already make money. Gates: quarterly revenue YoY ≥ 20%, TTM net income > 0, prior-year quarterly revenue ≥ $50M, ROE present. Rank: 60% 6-month relative strength versus QQQ, 40% return on equity. Revenue growth is a gate, not a score.

undervalued.name: Cheap on operating profit
undervalued.method: Cheap on operating profit: TTM operating income / market cap. Requires positive operating income, a consistent statement, and net margin between -20% and 80% when reported. The published list is the top 10% of that set, at most 150 names. The score is not a quality grade.
